title: Oke Shannon discussed on classified servers

tellings.quote: justifications. But, uh, Oak Shannon was a massive conversation on the classified servers

plain: In 2024, something called Oke Shannon was a big topic on the US government's top secret computer network, says Dylan Borland, a former intelligence analyst who says he saw it himself. In his words, "Oak Shannon was a massive conversation on the classified servers." He does not explain here what Oke Shannon is, but he tells it to show that insiders were talking about it in secret.
